meta.title: Privacy Policy for Fekra
meta.intro: This page explains what information Fekra collects, how we use it, when we share it, and the controls you have. It reflects the product features currently implemented in the platform.

summaryCards.title: What we collect
summaryCards.text: Account data, learning activity, purchases, uploads, device details, and support messages that keep the platform working.

summaryCards.title: Why we use it
summaryCards.text: To run accounts, deliver lessons, verify exams and homework, process purchases, support communication, and improve the service.

summaryCards.title: Who may receive it
summaryCards.text: Cloud storage, email, and verification providers that support Fekra under contract and only for service operations.

summaryCards.title: Your controls
summaryCards.text: You can review, correct, or request deletion of certain data, and you can manage language and login choices.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.summary: We collect the information needed to create accounts, manage access, support learning, and complete transactions.
items: Account and profile details such as name, email, phone number, password hash, gender, role, government, administration zone, level, hobby, referral source, user serial, and profile photo.
Student and parent relationship data, including children links, parent phone numbers, balances, lecture access, and referral metadata.
Teacher and lecturer details such as subject, levels taught, centers, school, social media handles, bio, expertise, and assigned lecturer references.
Learning records such as lecture access, attendance, exam submissions, homework submissions, scores, and progress.
Purchase and marketplace records such as product names, payment numbers, transfer numbers, payment screenshots, notes, coupon usage, and personalized book fields.
Technical data such as access and refresh tokens, local storage values, device/browser behavior, service-worker cache usage, and camera usage for QR or barcode scanning.
Support and communication data such as OTP verification records, password-reset requests, transactional emails, in-app messages, and bulk message delivery to parents.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Information
usage.summary: We use data to operate the platform and keep the educational and commerce flows working end to end.
items: Create and authenticate accounts, maintain sessions, and handle role-based access.
Deliver personalized learning content, track lecture access, and show progress and purchase history.
Verify homework and exam results through configured Google Sheets sources when a lecture requires it.
Process marketplace orders, confirm purchases, calculate discounts, and generate order serials.
Send OTPs, password-reset emails, purchase confirmations, and service messages.
Run QR and barcode workflows for live attendance, promo-code redemption, and related validation.
Improve reliability, detect abuse, debug errors, and protect the platform from fraud or unauthorized access.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing and Disclosures
sharing.summary: We do not sell your personal data. We only share data when it is needed to run the service or when required by law.
items: Cloudinary stores uploaded profile photos, product images, book samples, payment screenshots, and other media used by the platform.
Resend handles transactional emails such as email verification, password reset, and purchase confirmation messages.
Google Sheets is read for exam and homework verification when lecturers configure those workflows.
Service providers and infrastructure vendors may process data strictly for hosting, delivery, messaging, or security purposes under appropriate safeguards.
Parent or mentor coordination flows may expose limited student-related information where the platform is explicitly designed to do so.
We may disclose information when required to comply with law, respond to valid legal requests, or protect the rights, users, and security of the platform.

storage.title: 4. Data Storage and Security
storage.summary: We use practical safeguards, but no online system is perfectly secure.
items: Passwords are hashed before storage, and tokens are used for authenticated sessions rather than exposing credentials directly.
Uploads may be stored locally or in Cloudinary depending on the feature that handles them.
Audit logs record administrative actions, impersonation sessions, and resource changes for accountability and security review.
Cookies, local storage, and cached assets are used to keep language selection, login state, and app behavior consistent across visits.
We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to reduce unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration.

retention.title: 5. Retention
retention.summary: We keep some records only as long as needed for the feature that created them, support, legal obligations, or security review.
items: OTP records expire after about 10 minutes unless consumed sooner.
Password-reset verification data and reset tokens are short-lived and are cleared after use or expiry.
Access tokens last about 30 minutes, while refresh tokens can remain valid for up to 7 days unless revoked earlier.
Audit logs, purchases, attendance, and exam records may be retained longer for education, accounting, dispute handling, or security purposes.
When a record is no longer needed, we delete it or keep only what is necessary for legal or operational reasons.

children.title: 6. Children and Guardian Safeguards
children.summary: Fekra may be used by learners of different ages, but we expect parent or guardian involvement where local law or the product flow requires it.
items: Parent accounts are designed to connect child data and to support monitoring, coordination, and communication.
We collect only the information needed to deliver learning and account features, and we avoid collecting more than is required for the service.
If we learn that information was provided in a way that is not permitted, we may restrict access or delete the data as appropriate.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights and Choices
rights.summary: You can control much of your data through your account and by contacting us directly.
items: Access, review, or correct the personal data you provided where the product allows it.
Request deletion of certain data, subject to legal, accounting, security, or operational obligations.
Manage language and login choices through your browser or account settings where available.
Stop using camera-based features when you do not want QR or barcode scanning to run.
Contact us if you believe a record is inaccurate, unnecessary, or handled incorrectly.

changes.title: 8. Updates to This Policy
changes.summary: We may update this policy as the product changes or legal requirements evolve.
items: We will post the updated policy on this page and refresh the date shown above.
Material changes may also be reflected in product notices, banner messages, or related communication channels when appropriate.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: For privacy requests, questions, or corrections, contact the Fekra Team at the address below.
contact.name: Fekra Team
contact.response: We review privacy requests through the support inbox.
